comment: No source is published. The module looks at the left-hand expander slot and checks that the neighbour's model is Modal Filter, so it is inert anywhere else. Each voice offset runs minus 1 to plus 1, and is turned into a frequency either as the filter frequency times 2 to the power of twice the offset, which is 24 semitones at the end of the knob, or as the filter frequency plus the offset times 500Hz, according to the unit switch, and the result is clamped to between 20Hz and 0.4899 of the sample rate. The switch defaults to semitones. A muted voice is skipped entirely. The five mute buttons are plain parameters used as latches, each with its own lamp. Nothing in the plugin reads a channel count, so every port is mono. The panel menu carries only Reload panel and Poll SVG for reload, which every module in this plugin has and which only reload the panel artwork.
